sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN member_id END) AS first_buyer_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN net_sales_cents ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , SUM(CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN order_rank >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_order_count
FROM "data"."main"."valid_member_orders_ranked" valid_member_orders_ranked_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
answer: 2026年8月，青禾客户范围内：观测期首购会员数为5个CRM会员账户；观测期首单净销售额为128.00元；观测期首单数为5笔；观测期后续购买订单数为22笔。首购/首单口径是先在完整测试覆盖期内确定每个账户的第一笔有效订单，再筛选落入2026年8月窗口的订单；后续购买订单数按账户第二笔及以后有效订单的订单日期落入8月窗口计数，不等同于复购人数。
